title: Procedural Highlands
concept: Warped seeded terrain regions produce mesas, rounded mountain groups or stepped uplands.
difference_from_base: Uses a seeded region partition and distance to cell borders rather than reusing a Skirmish terrain style.
intended_players: 1v1 or two teams, with diagonal, north-south and east-west symmetry.
routes: Natural inter-region valleys and automatic Skirmish tank ramp carving connect opposing bases and economy.
economy: Automatic mirrored resource placement; three protected opening spots per side, expansion density handled by existing core rules.
known_weaknesses: Advanced extreme relief may require many ramps or leave fewer accessible expansions.
core_wishes: Expose the existing procedural carver/resource helpers as a supported public template API.
